meta.name: email-drip-sequence
meta.description: Write an email drip sequence for affiliate marketing. Triggers on: "write me an email sequence", "create a drip campaign", "email nurture sequence", "affiliate email funnel", "welcome email series", "email onboarding sequence", "write emails for my list", "set up a drip sequence", "email campaign for [product]", "nurture my subscribers", "email follow-up sequence", "build my email funnel", "write 5 emails promoting [product]", "email automation sequence".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动撰写联盟营销邮件滴灌序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用自动化邮件序列推广联盟产品
copy.tagline_en: Write email drip sequences for affiliate marketing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated email sequences to promote affiliate products

howto.what: 当用户要求写邮件序列时，Claude会生成一个5-7封邮件的drip序列，每封包含主题行、预览文本、正文和行动号召，按“欢迎→价值→软销售→硬销售→异议处理→跟进”的模式排列。
howto.when: 当你提到“写一个邮件序列”、“创建drip活动”或要求为某个产品写推广邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个5封邮件的培育序列，推广HeyGen给内容创作者。
say.note: Claude会要求提供产品和受众细节，然后生成序列。

say.text: 为我的Notion模板联盟项目写一个欢迎序列。
say.note: 如果没有提供联盟链接，Claude会提示填写。

say.text: 给我写一个7封邮件的销售漏斗，受众是SaaS创业者。
say.note: Claude会使用默认设置或请求补充信息。

howto.what_en: When you ask for an email sequence, Claude generates a 5-7 email drip sequence including subject lines, preview text, body, and CTA, following a Welcome → Value → Soft Sell → Hard Sell → Objection Handling → Follow-Up pattern.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'write me an email sequence', 'create a drip campaign', or ask for affiliate email funnels.

say_en.text: Write a 5-email nurture sequence promoting HeyGen for content creators.
say_en.note: Claude asks for product and audience details, then generates the sequence.

say_en.text: Create a welcome series for my Notion template affiliate program.
say_en.note: If no affiliate link is given, Claude prompts for it.

say_en.text: Generate a 7-email sales funnel targeting SaaS founders.
say_en.note: Claude uses defaults or requests missing info.
